description: The chart displays three pie charts representing the distribution of categories across three difficulty levels: easy, medium, and hard. Each pie chart is divided into four slices, corresponding to the categories N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-, which are distinguished by different colors as indicated in the legend on the right. The easy chart has slices labeled with percentages: N+K+ (40.6%, green), N-K- (45.9%, orange), N+K- (3.3%, red), and N-K+ (10.1%, yellow). The medium chart also has percentage labels: N+K+ (44.6%, green), N-K+ (7.2%, yellow), N-K- (44.3%, orange), and N+K- (3.9%, red). The hard chart is similarly labeled: N+K+ (36.2%, green), N-K+ (20.1%, yellow), N-K- (36.8%, orange), and N+K- (7.0%, red). The charts do not have any visually emphasized slices, and the slices are not ordered in a particular way across the charts, but within each chart, the slices are arranged in a clockwise direction. The legend is provided to the right of the charts, indicating the color corresponding to each category.
